portal_description:
The scipy package provides the Scientific Tools for Python (SciPy) library. The SciPy library provides Python language routines for statistics, numerical integration, optimization, linear algebra, signal processing, and other scientific data manipulation methods.

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.5 Release Notes linked from the References section.

Users of scipy are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
